name: HERO
lines: EcoStudy is a learning and growth platform that helps you turn what you read, watch, hear, and experience into knowledge you understand, remember, connect, practice, and use.
Study deeply. Build knowledge that lasts. Practice what you learn. Grow your capacity. See what your growth produces.
*Books · PDFs · Videos · Articles · Audio · Courses · Notes · Real-life learning*

name: THE PROBLEM
lines: ### We consume more information than ever.
# But consuming isn't the same as learning.
Then, weeks later, much of it is difficult to recall — disconnected from what you already know and even harder to use when life actually requires it.
The problem isn't access to information.
**The problem is turning information into knowledge that grows, stays, connects, and becomes useful.**

name: THE IDEA
lines: ### Learning is an ecosystem, not a filing system.
In the real world, healthy things don't grow in isolation.
They develop roots. They form connections. They strengthen over time. They bear fruit.
We believe knowledge works the same way.
EcoStudy gives you a living structure for growing what you know — from the areas of life you care about to the smallest concepts you're trying to master.
The knowledge that makes it grow.
Instead of collecting disconnected information, you begin building an ecosystem of understanding.

name: RESOURCE LIBRARY
lines: ### Everything you're learning from. One place.
Books. PDFs. Reports. Research papers. Articles. YouTube videos. Audio. Podcasts. Courses. Websites. Notes.
Save your learning resources to EcoStudy and organize them by the areas of your life and knowledge they support.
Filter by Life Area, Sub-Life Area, resource type, Tree, Branch, Fruit, and more whenever you need to find something again.
Then open a resource directly in your Study Workspace and begin learning.

name: STUDY
lines: Every study session can have a purpose.
Choose what you need from the knowledge in front of you, and EcoStudy shapes the session around that intention.
Get a quick sense of what something is, why it matters, and whether you need to go deeper.
Uncover its foundations, definitions, components, mechanics, boundaries, and examples.
Extract principles, relationships, patterns, assumptions, trade-offs, nuances, evidence, and implications.
Explain, compare, reason, analyze, predict, question, solve, and work through the knowledge yourself.
Bring the knowledge back without relying on your notes or source material.
Connect new knowledge to what you already know and allow it to reshape your understanding.
Use spaced retrieval, reinforcement, and repeated encounters to build durable knowledge.
Assess what you know, what you don't, and what deserves attention next.
Determine whether a Fruit has developed enough understanding, retrieval, reasoning, connection, and durability to move into deeper practice.

name: STUDY WORKSPACE
lines: ### Your resource. Your intention. Your focus.
Open a resource and focus on the work in front of you.
Save discoveries directly into your Forests, Groves, Trees, Roots, Stems, Branches, Leaves, or Fruits.
Take notes without leaving your resource.
Ask questions when you need help.
Choose a Study Intention for the session.
And keep your focus with a built-in timer or Pomodoro sessions with scheduled breaks.
**Just you, the resource, and the work of learning.**

name: KNOWLEDGE ECOSYSTEM
lines: ### Don't leave what you learn scattered.
As you learn, EcoStudy helps you actively manage your growing Knowledge Ecosystem.
Plant it and give it somewhere to grow.
Isolate it without losing where it came from.
Link knowledge across Trees, Groves, and Forests.
Found something incorrect, outdated, redundant, or poorly placed?
Refine your ecosystem and keep it healthy.
Over time, what once felt like separate subjects begins to become a connected body of knowledge that belongs to you.

name: FROM LEARNING TO DOING
lines: ### Knowing is not the finish line.
What you learn should eventually meet practice.
Stretch is EcoStudy's application workspace — where knowledge is rehearsed, practiced, performed, adapted, and used.
Practice internally through reflection and mental rehearsal.
Practice safely through simulations and scenarios.
Practice externally in school, work, business, relationships, projects, and real life.
EcoStudy can recommend Stretch practices from the knowledge you're growing, gaps discovered during Study, the goals you're pursuing, and opportunities happening in your life.

name: LEARNING + DOING
lines: ### Don't choose between learning and doing.
Use it in the real world.
That is how knowledge becomes capability.
Whether your rhythm is daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly, EcoStudy helps you keep learning and practice connected.

name: HARVEST
lines: When knowledge is used, something can come from it.
EcoStudy calls these **Harvests** — evidence of what your learning and practice are producing.
Don't only track how many hours you studied.

name: BARNS
lines: ### Knowledge tells you what you know.
# BARNS helps you see what you're becoming able to carry.
Growth isn't only about knowing more.
It's also about becoming capable of handling greater complexity, responsibility, opportunity, pressure, influence, and impact.
It brings together evidence from your knowledge, Study, Stretch, Goals, and Harvests to help you understand how your capacity is developing across 16 areas:
Choose a capacity you want to intentionally build, create a focused Build, and develop it over 7, 30, 90 days, or your own timeframe.
Or simply keep using EcoStudy and allow BARNS to identify capacity growth from the evidence your learning and practice produce.

name: GOALS
lines: ### Give your growth somewhere to go.
# Connect today's learning to tomorrow's goals.

Then connect your goals to the Life Areas that matter, the knowledge you need to grow, the capacity you need to develop, the Study you need to complete, and the Stretch practices that will move you forward.
A 20-minute Study session today shouldn't feel disconnected from the person you're trying to become this year.
EcoStudy helps you see the line between them.

name: GROWTH
lines: ### Hours tell you how long you studied.
See how your learning develops over time.
See which Fruits are developing, taking root, ripening, or ready to Stretch.
See where your knowledge is strong and where it is weakening.
See where your time and attention are going across your Life Areas.
And discover patterns in how you learn best.
Your Growth view brings the story together:

name: THE WHOLE SYSTEM
lines: ### One ecosystem for learning and growth.
What am I trying to grow, become, accomplish, or produce?
What do I need to know?
How will I understand, process, retrieve, and retain it?
How will I practice and use it?
What did that learning and practice produce?
What am I becoming capable of carrying?
How am I changing over time?
EcoStudy brings the pieces together so that learning doesn't end when you close the book.

name: WHO ECOSTUDY IS FOR
lines: ### Built for people who intend to keep growing.
Build knowledge you can remember, connect, and carry beyond the classroom.
Turn books, courses, reports, workplace learning, and experience into knowledge and capability you can actually use.
Give everything you're curious about somewhere to grow.
Connect what you're learning to the things you're building, leading, solving, and creating.
If there is something you need to understand, practice, develop, or become capable of carrying, there is something to grow.

name: FINAL CTA
lines: The responsibilities you're preparing to carry.
Give all of it somewhere to grow.
*Plant the question. Grow the knowledge. Stretch the capability. Harvest the result.*

name: FOOTER
lines: *Your knowledge is an ecosystem. Grow it.*
